positive_snippets: Nice room and staff is very helpfull.Salman is in reception always ready to help the traveller
negative_snippets:
Worst experience in this hotel. The owners behaved like goons at checkout and started demanding extra money saying I had extended checkout time at 11 am while the checkout is mentioned as 12. They then threatened me that I won't walk out of the hotel if I don't pay extra.

Rooms are infected with cockroaches and they did nothing about it in spite of complaining.

The hotel itself is in a very narrow dirty and dingy lane.

There are hundreds of better hotels in Paharganj so avoid this at all costs.
Not at all worth the money
When going checkout time we have pending balance for the room. Due to non change they  tell us they will send it online after checkout time. But till this time they return back the balance amount

Worst experience ever
Unhygienic rooms, there were lots n lots of small cockroaches, bedsheet was not clean
Seems like dusting never happened in the room.
And the more imp thing was..the person who was at the reception asked us to pay rs 180 extra for GST and was not providing any gst bill.
This was really unprofessional. They make people fool and the visitors end up paying extra money.
